newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London firm before FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London firm before FOMC.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were slightly firmer on Tuesday but volumes remained low as investors played safe ahead of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee meeting, dealers said.
"We've seen some interest in banks but, ahead of the FOMC, you can't really expect too much," one dealer said, adding that an expected quarter point rise had been discounted.

In London, the Nikkei 50 index was up 1.68 points at 1,429.38 by 1315 GMT, after Tokyo's Nikkei 225 Average closed 59.75 points higher at 21,171.99. Dealers expected the London market to hold steady for the remainder of the day.
Among movers, Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi was firm after it said it would make an earlier-than-scheduled redemption of eurodollar convertible bonds.
"The bond was called in above the market price and that dragged the share, and other banks, higher," one trader said.

Another dealer said there had been some money spread across blue chips by UK pension funds. "There seems to be people thinking that a lot of the bad news is out of these companies and it's time to get back in. But the flow of funds is not so great," he said.
